Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 119: February 2011
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #119 shipped to subscribers in January 2011 (bearing the cover date of February 2011 for Issue 119). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #119 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom downloadable content, and exclusive media previews:

Dragon Age II (action role-playing game)
LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars (action-adventure platformer)
Homefront (first-person shooter)
Outland (Xbox Live Arcade action puzzle-platformer)
Islands of Wakfu (Xbox Live Arcade tactical action RPG)
Stacking (Xbox Live Arcade adventure puzzle)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews--featuring coverage for The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim, Modern Warfare 3, and Batman: Arkham City, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
